GET roster passes untrusted cohortId to getCohortRosterForRequester with no requireCourseAccess gate (unlike roster-export/summary which call it first). getCohortRosterForRequester returns all enrollments in the cohort (names, and with sharingMode=staff_directory emails+phones), so any authenticated user can read PII of any cohort's roster.

GET staff-directory calls getCohortStaffDirectory(user, cohortId) with no requireCourseAccess. It returns the full roster (student names + enrollment status) for any cohort regardless of requester's enrollment/assignment; only contact detail inclusion is gated. Staff-only surface readable by any authenticated student.
